theme.designMd:
# Portfolio Scrollytelling Design System

Polished, professional dark UI. Calm reveals, restrained motion, content first.
Carries over the current site look: slate background, emerald accent.

## Colors
| Role | Hex |
|---|---|
| Background | #0F172A (slate-900) |
| Background deep | #020617 (slate-950) |
| Surface / card | #1E293B (slate-800) |
| Border | #334155 (slate-700) |
| Text | #F1F5F9 |
| Muted text | #CBD5E1 |
| Accent (emerald) | #34D399 -> #059669 gradient, used for highlighted words and the active progress dot |

## Typography
Inter. H1 56px/1.2, H2 32px/1.3, body 18px/1.6, labels 12px uppercase tracking-wide. Highlighted words (`<b>`) use the emerald gradient.

## Shape and spacing
Radius 12px. 8px spacing grid. Thin 1px borders, soft shadows, no glows.

## Layout and motion
- Desktop: two columns. Text steps scroll on the left, the visual stays pinned on the right (sticky, 100svh).
- Mobile: stacked, no pinning, visual sits inline above each step.
- Slim progress rail on the right edge: one dot per chapter, active dot is emerald, labels on hover. Becomes a top progress bar on mobile.
- Starfield particles stay as the fixed backdrop.
- Motion: fades and small translates under 0.5s; inactive steps at 25% opacity. All motion off under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Chapters
1. Hello: name, role, tagline.
2. Person: hobbies (video games, camping, kayaking) and mentoring. Photos on the sticky panel.
3. Career: pinned timeline. Each step swaps the sticky card (company, role, period, stack).
4. Skills + AI: steps through Frontend, Backend, Cloud and DevOps, Testing, then "How I work with AI". Sticky panel shows tech logos, then an AI workflow diagram.
5. Contact: links and CV downloads.

screens.prompt:
Design a portfolio landing hero for Joren, Full-Stack Web Developer.
PLATFORM: Desktop-first web design.
THEME & PALETTE: Dark slate slate-900 / slate-950 background with emerald green (#34D399) glowing accents and clean white/slate typography.
BACKGROUND: Subtle interactive or CSS-rendered starfield canvas/background with soft glowing nebula dust or twinkling ambient stars.
STRUCTURE & LAYOUT:
1. Header / Top Navigation: Minimalist bar with logo 'Joren', navigation links (About, Career, Skills & AI, Contact), 'Resume' and emerald accent CTA 'Get in Touch'.
2. Right edge: Slim vertical progress rail fixed on the right margin with 5 indicator dots and chapter labels:
   - 1. Hello (ACTIVE state: glowing emerald dot with pulse ring, highlighted label)
   - 2. Person
   - 3. Career
   - 4. Skills & AI
   - 5. Contact
3. Centered Hero section:
   - Small badge or pill tag: 'AVAILABLE FOR NEW PROJECTS' with an emerald pulsating status indicator.
   - Main Headline: "I'm Joren, a Full-Stack Web Developer" in bold, modern sans-serif typography with emerald gradient highlight.
   - Subtitle: "Loves clean code, smooth interfaces, and well-oiled pipelines" in crisp slate-300 with high readability.
   - Action buttons: Primary emerald button "View My Work" or "Explore Projects" and secondary ghost border button "Read My Story" / "Tech Stack".
   - Quick tech stack badges or floating developer metrics: e.g. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Cloud / DevOps.
4. Bottom scroll cue:
   - Subtle scroll-down cue with mouse icon or down arrow animation and text "Scroll to explore".
Ensure sleek spacing, modern developer aesthetic, smooth dark mode styling matching {{DATA:DESIGN_SYSTEM:DESIGN_SYSTEM_1}}.
screens.title: Joren — Developer Portfolio Hero

outputComponents.text:
Here is the desktop portfolio landing hero for **Joren, Full-Stack Web Developer**:

### Key Features & Design Choices:
- **Atmospheric Starfield**: Deep slate-950 backdrop with ambient twinkling stars and subtle emerald glow for a polished modern developer feel.
- **Centered Hero Layout**:
  - Availability pill badge (`AVAILABLE FOR NEW PROJECTS`) with glowing indicator.
  - Bold headline: *"I'm Joren, a Full-Stack Web Developer"* featuring emerald gradient emphasis.
  - Subtitle: *"Loves clean code, smooth interfaces, and well-oiled pipelines"*, backed by dual CTA buttons (*Explore Projects* & *Read My Story*).
  - Quick-glance core engineering stack tags (*React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Cloud & DevOps, AI Integration*).
- **Vertical Progress Rail**: Slim chapter navigation anchored to the right margin with 5 chapters (*Hello*, *Person*, *Career*, *Skills & AI*, *Contact*), where the first chapter (*Hello*) is set to active with an emerald beacon ring.
- **Scroll Cue**: Subtle animated scroll mouse indicator anchored to guide visitor momentum down the page.

outputComponents.suggestion: Add the 'Person' (About) section below the hero
